# openmetadata_llm_model (Data Source)

Looks up a single OpenMetadata LLM model by id or fully qualified name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openmetadata_llm_model" "chat" {
  fully_qualified_name = "openai.gpt-4o"
}

output "chat_model_id" {
  value = data.openmetadata_llm_model.chat.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) LLM model fully qualified name. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.
- `id` (String) LLM model UUID. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.

### Read-Only

- `base_model` (String) Base model the deployment serves.
- `description` (String) Markdown description.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `model_provider` (String) Provider of the base model.
- `model_version` (String) Version of the base model.
- `name` (String) LLM model name.
- `service` (String) Fully qualified name of the parent LLM service.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.
